_comment: role: merchant | villager | quest. anchor names refer to anchors emitted by the village structure template.

greet.en: Welcome, traveler. Moonfall has been waiting for someone like you.
greet.zh: 欢迎，旅行者。月落村一直在等待像你这样的人。

chat.en: The ruins to the far side of the road glow at night. Nobody goes there anymore.
chat.zh: 大路尽头的遗迹在夜里会发光，如今已经没人敢去了。

chat.en: What you build here will stay. This land remembers.
chat.zh: 你在这里建造的一切都会留下，这片土地会记住。

after_boss.en: The lanterns are lit again! You have given us back the night.
after_boss.zh: 月灯重新亮起来了！你把夜晚还给了我们。

greet.en: Finest goods this side of the river!
greet.zh: 河这边最好的货都在我这儿！

chat.en: I trade in coin. Bandits carry plenty, if you can take it from them.
chat.zh: 我只收钱币。强盗身上有不少，前提是你抢得过来。

after_boss.en: Business is booming now that the roads are safe at night.
after_boss.zh: 夜路安全之后，生意好多了。

greet.en: Need steel? Or at least copper?
greet.zh: 需要钢铁吗？至少来点铜？

chat.en: Iron veins hide in the mountains. You will want a copper tool first.
chat.zh: 铁矿脉藏在山里，你得先有一把铜制工具。

after_boss.en: Bring me a Moon Core and iron sword and I'll tell you what to do at the anvil.
after_boss.zh: 带上月核和铁剑，我告诉你在铁砧上该怎么做。

greet.en: Good soil here. Everything grows if you give it time.
greet.zh: 这儿土好，只要给时间，什么都能长。

chat.en: Till the ground with a hoe, plant seeds, and wait. Crops keep growing while you are away.
chat.zh: 用锄头翻地，播下种子，然后等待。你不在的时候作物也会生长。

after_boss.en: The wheat looks silver under the lanterns.
after_boss.zh: 月灯下的麦子泛着银光。

chat.en: Wolves hunt in the snow up north. Scorpions own the canyon to the south.
chat.zh: 北边雪地里有狼群，南边峡谷是蝎子的地盘。

after_boss.en: Even the wolves are calmer now.

greet.en: Did you see the falling star?!

chat.en: Sometimes stars fall at night. If you find one, can I see it?
chat.zh: 夜里有时会有星星掉下来。你要是找到了，能给我看看吗？
